mods.name: diff-stats
mods.description: Edit and Write rows show a compact +12 -3 bar beside the file name: green for lines added, red for lines removed, up to 20 cells.

mods.name: file-links
mods.description: In Claude's replies, path/to/file.ts:42 references to files in your project become links. Click one to put @path/to/file.ts in the prompt.

mods.name: render-pack
mods.description: Both original rendering mods in one: diff-stats bars on Edit and Write rows, and file-links in Claude's replies (a click puts @path in the prompt).
